sources.summary: Plan requires five JSON artifacts, checklist enforcement, workflow upgrades, and aligned repo rules.
Checklist originally ran lint, typecheck, tests, and env parity without artifact validation.
Debug workflow had reproduce, isolate, root cause, fix, and learn phases but no mandatory Scout and Diagnose gate.
Planning workflow created task breakdowns but did not require the five-part contract or fast-mode contract.
Code workflow required TDD and checks but did not block implementation on validated plan and risk artifacts.
